caption:
Solo in Osaka on ¥5,000 a night? Book a weeknight 🛏️

We priced the same two nights in December 2026, all within 1 km of Namba Station. On the Saturday, the cheapest private room jumped to ¥11,130.

🥇 Weeknight: Toho Hotel Namba Motomachi, economy single, ¥5,015 (Wed)
• Its own toilet and shower: the cheapest fully private room we found that night.
• Just ¥15 over budget, for a lockable room and a shower nobody else uses. That's how you do Osaka cheaply: move your Namba nights midweek.
• Finish the evening by the canal, walk back, and close a door that's yours alone.

🥈 Saturday: Capsule Hotel Asahi Plaza Shinsaibashi, ¥5,000
• The cheapest bed within 1 km that night: a bed, a locker and a shower.
• It's the pick for a Friday or Saturday out: sleep close to where you finish.
• Check before booking: several capsules are men-only or keep separate floors.

💡 Most people miss this: Hotel LEAP's single was about ¥2,998 on the Wednesday, but its toilet is shared. Read the facilities before you book.

Two minutes from those capsules there's a moss-covered statue people splash for luck, and how to do it properly is in our guide 👆 link in bio (or DM us PRIVACY).
Prices change daily: these are the two nights we sampled, so check your own dates.
